evidence.section: Compatibility information for AI agents > Triage and Response
evidence.statement: Three live AI citation IDs map to two retired ES 8.8 English paths. Both returned 404 on direct requests. The current English agent compatibility and Triage/Response task pages returned usable content and supported the scoped aggregate and detailed comparisons. The Editions view already uses the working paths. The immutable 1.2.0 registry requires those original canonical URL mappings, so the alternative locators are recorded here for a versioned reconciliation.
